content: {"reasoning":"Prior authorization is required for CPT 93229 and is missing, and silverbridge offers no retroactive authorization window and no peer-to-peer review, so any submission now would draw a CO-197 auth denial and an appeal is not yet possible without a denial on the table. Billing the patient or writing off would forfeit the $746.09 allowed amount inappropriately, and there is no data error to correct. With 158 days of timely filing left and mediocre documentation (0.57), a human specialist is best positioned to pursue an authorization exception/backdated auth with the payer and shore up the clinical record before submission.","action":"escalate"}
